# Input group

> Joined input wrapper for addons, icons, and a shared focus indicator.

This file matches the installed `input-group` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/input-group.json
```

With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/input-group.md`.

## npm dependencies

- `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0`

## Registry dependencies

- `core`

## Exports

- `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/field-knobs`: `fieldKnobs`, types `FieldKnobStyle`
- `@/components/control-ui/ui/input-group`: `useIsInsideInputGroup`, `useInputGroupControlRef`, `InputGroup`, `InputGroupAddon`, types `InputGroupProps`, `InputGroupAddonProps`

## Composition

### Input with addons

```tsx
<InputGroup>
  <InputGroupAddon>
    addon content
  </InputGroupAddon>
  <Input />
</InputGroup>
```

## Usage

```tsx
"use client";

import { SearchIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldLabel } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/field";
import { Input } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/input";
import { InputGroup, InputGroupAddon } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/input-group";
import { Kbd } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/kbd";
import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography";

export function PrimitiveInputGroupExample() {
  return (
    <div className="flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col gap-6">
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel>URL</FieldLabel>
        <InputGroup>
          <InputGroupAddon>/dashboard/</InputGroupAddon>
          <Input defaultValue="reflet" />
        </InputGroup>
        <FieldDescription>Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens</FieldDescription>
      </Field>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <Text size="caption" weight="medium" tone="muted">
          Addon + field
        </Text>
        <InputGroup size="sm">
          <InputGroupAddon>
            <SearchIcon aria-hidden="true" />
          </InputGroupAddon>
          <Input type="search" aria-label="Search documentation" placeholder="Search documentation…" />
          <InputGroupAddon>
            <Kbd>⌘K</Kbd>
          </InputGroupAddon>
        </InputGroup>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <Text size="caption" weight="medium" tone="muted">
          Render prop — the group renders as a button
        </Text>
        <InputGroup render={<button type="button" aria-label="Search documentation" />} size="sm">
          <InputGroupAddon>
            <SearchIcon aria-hidden="true" />
          </InputGroupAddon>
          <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">Search documentation...</span>
          <Kbd>⌘K</Kbd>
        </InputGroup>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`.

- `input-group`

  - `root`: `data-size` (`lg` | `md` | `sm` | `xs`)
